name: @neo4j-nvl/base
notes: Proprietary renderer. Imports @segment/analytics-next unconditionally; analytics needs an explicit API key. Touches document at import time, so no SSR. 13 direct dependencies, several pinned exactly.

build_vs_buy.effort: 6-12 months for a WebGL graph renderer
build_vs_buy.rationale: The renderer is the expensive part; the licence makes this particular buy conditional.

prior_versions.note: Same proprietary licence. Pins mobx 3.6.2 (vs 6.15.0 in 2.0.0) and keeps the Segment analytics dependency; importing it still touches document. No advisories.
